items.title: Agent-to-Agent Interoperability between AWS and SAP
items.summary: This blog is co-authored with Vikas Motiwal (SAP), Kay Schmitteckert (SAP) and Praveen Padegal (SAP) AWS and SAP now support the agentic integration via open protocols, enabling autonomous cross-system business processes at enterprise scale. The autonomous enterprise depends on AI agents that can complete business processes that run across both SAP and non-SAP applications. As […]
